name: Globesecure Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, Globesecure Technologies Limited is in the business of IT Security products and related services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GSTL is a digital transformation company with a focus on cyber security. Company has executed cybersecurity transformation projects, infrastructure, and digital transformation projects for various institutions and also provided similar independent services viz. consultation, architecture, solution design, implementation, monitoring and providing managed services
a) Cybersecurity:
MDR services, cloud security services, data protection, email security, endpoint security, Email security, and Office 360 security
b) Integrated Enterprise Solution:
Design and implement Network Infrastructure, LAN WAN0, Wi-Fi solutions, server, storage, backup, BCP, unified communication, Software Defined Networking, SDWAN, next-gen and network transformation
c) Managed Services:
Third-party services for infrastructure, IT, and other technical support
